links.outcome: Physician rare-disease diagnostic accuracy with LLM assistance versus internet search alone
links.effect: RaDaR assistance improved physicians' rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points compared with internet search alone.
links.quote: In a randomized physician-assistance trial, RaDaR assistance improved physicians' rare-disease diagnostic accuracy by 21.44 percentage points compared with internet search alone.

unlisted_practices: Training a compact open-source reasoning LLM with synthetic phenotype-anchored cases to address data scarcity in rare disease diagnosis
Retrospective lead-time analysis of AI diagnosis versus documented clinical suspicion

screen.reason: The paper features a randomized controlled reader trial evaluating physician diagnostic performance with vs. without LLM assistance (vs. standard internet search).
